explanation: In the first CI run, line 71 of agent/agent.py was intentionally modified to unconditionally call cancel_order on customer cancellation requests without checking delivery status. This broke regression case e-006 (where Order #2 is already delivered and must not be cancelled), causing 4 out of 5 trials to fail and triggering a blocking CI failure. In the second CI run, this instruction was reverted to enforce checking pre-shipment ('placed') status before cancellation. As a result, the agent correctly identified the delivered status, refused cancellation, passed 5 out of 5 trials, and allowed the CI workflow to pass.
